Container.Name: Fliparr
Container.Overview:
Fliparr is Tinder-style swiping for Radarr's movie recommendations. Radarr's Discover tab is a wall of text where every suggestion needs a checkbox and a trip to the footer bar; Fliparr turns it into a deck of cards. One film fills your phone screen — poster, IMDb/Rotten Tomatoes/Metacritic ratings, genres, synopsis, trailer — and you decide with a swipe.
Swipe right to add the movie to Radarr, monitored, with a release search started. Swipe left to write it to Radarr's Import List Exclusions so it never comes back. Undo reverses either one, up to 50 swipes deep. Watch trailers in a sheet without leaving the deck, filter by genre, and review a reversible history of every decision.
Set Radarr's address and API key in the app's Settings screen with a Test button; quality profile, root folder, monitor mode and search-on-add are read live from your Radarr. Runs LAN-only with no login and no cloud — your API key stays server-side and is never sent to the browser. Requires a Radarr v3 instance with some movies already in the library.
Point Radarr URL at host.docker.internal (this template adds the host-gateway mapping) rather than the host LAN IP, which can break on a container recreate.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Fliparr web UI. Clear of Radarr (7878), Sonarr (8989), Prowlarr (9696).

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Stores the Radarr connection, settings, and undo history. Mount it or these reset on recreate.

Config.Name: Radarr URL
Config.Description: Radarr's address. Keep host.docker.internal if Radarr runs on this Unraid server; otherwise use its LAN IP. Seeds a fresh install — once you save a connection in the app, that one wins.

Config.Name: Radarr API Key
Config.Description: Radarr → Settings → General → API Key. Treat it like a password. Seeds a fresh install; can also be set in the app's Settings screen.
